**About 4flow**
 4flow is a global leader in logistics optimization, with a team of over 1,500 professionals across more than 20 locations worldwide. Our unique business model integrates supply chain consulting, advanced logistics software, 4PL services, and cutting\-edge logistics research to deliver innovative and end\-to\-end solutions.
   

  

 Our Bangalore office, located in Manyata Tech Park, is one of our newest and most dynamic hubs. Here, we are building a next\-generation, AI\-driven supply chain product from the ground up. Operating in a hybrid work model, this location offers a unique opportunity to join the development team at an early stage and play a key role in shaping the future of our product and technology landscape.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with 6\+ years of experience to build scalable and intuitive frontend applications for our Business Insights platform within the 4PL ecosystem.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Vue.js, frontend engineering best practices, and modern UI/UX principles, along with experience building analytics dashboards and enterprise business applications. This role involves close collaboration with product, backend, AI, and data engineering teams to deliver high\-quality user experiences for analytics and AI\-powered insights.
   

  

**What your new challenge will look like**
* 6\+ years of frontend development experience with strong expertise in Vue.js and enterprise web application development.
* Design and develop scalable frontend applications using Vue.js (preferably Vue 3\), JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frontend tools.
* Build reusable, maintainable UI components and frontend modules.
* Develop responsive, high\-performance interfaces for analytics dashboards, KPI monitoring, operational insights, and AI\-powered business applications.
* Collaborate with product and UX teams to create intuitive, user\-friendly experiences.
* Translate business requirements and workflows into engaging frontend solutions.
* Contribute to design systems, reusable component libraries, and maintain consistency in styling, responsiveness, and accessibility.
* Build interactive dashboards and analytical interfaces using modern visualization libraries.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, analytics platforms, and real\-time data services.
* Optimize UI responsiveness, rendering performance, and API interactions for large datasets.
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and responsive behavior across devices.
* Follow best practices for code quality, testing, maintainability, and secure frontend development.
* Work closely with product managers, backend engineers, data engineers, AI/ML teams, and UX designers.
* Participate in sprint planning, technical discussions, and code reviews.
* Strong proficiency in Vue.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3\.
* Experience with Pinia/Vuex, REST APIs, WebSocket integrations, and build tools such as Vite or Webpack.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, accessibility standards, and user\-centered design.
* Experience working with design systems, wireframes, mockups, and reusable component libraries.
* Ability to transform complex analytical workflows into clean, intuitive user interfaces.
* Hands\-on experience with visualization libraries such as ECharts, Chart.js, and D3\.js.
* Experience building analytics dashboards, SaaS products, or enterprise business applications.
* Strong knowledge of Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, frontend testing, and performance optimization.
* Nice to have experience with AI\-assisted/conversational interfaces, micro\-frontends, cloud\-native deployments, logistics or supply chain platforms, and ClickHouse\-based analytics applications.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Success measured by delivering scalable and responsive applications, improving usability and adoption, creating reusable frontend components, and enabling seamless integration with analytics and AI systems.


**Why you belong at 4flow**
* Opportunity to build next\-generation AI\-powered business intelligence products.
* Work with modern frontend technologies and scalable architectures.
* Collaborative engineering culture with strong ownership.
* Exposure to analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale platforms.


**What we offer**
* A stable role within a company rooted in strong German roots, backed by a clear vision and long\-term security.
* A dynamic, international work environment with excellent opportunities for rapid career growth.
* Extensive professional development support, including a dedicated training budget and access to internal learning programs.
* A permanent position with a competitive base salary, attractive bonus structure, and comprehensive benefits package.
* Hybrid work model
* Access to an Employee Assistance Program to support your mental well\-being.
* Regular sports activities, team events, and company getaways that foster connection and collaboration.
* Complimentary lunch, beverages, and coffee at all 4flow locations.
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage, including GMC, GPA, GTL, and OPD.

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Industry: Software Development
Seniority level: Mid\-Senior level  



Experience: 5\+ yrs



Location: Bengaluru



Job Type: Full\-time



We’re hiring fullstack engineers (SDE\-2 through Staff) to own this surface end\-to\-end: from rich, reactive frontends to backend services and workflows that power them.



What changes across levels is scope, ambiguity, and influence — but at every level, you’ll write code, ship product, and operate across the frontend\-backend boundary.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Frontend Development**



Design and build intuitive, high\-quality user interfaces that handle complex workflows — task tracking, state transitions, approvals, and user actions.



Senior and Staff engineers define reusable patterns and UI primitives for teams.


### **Fullstack Feature Ownership**



Own features across the stack:


* Build React frontends
* Design and implement APIs
* Ensure seamless integration between UI and backend systems


SDE\-2s execute with guidance, Seniors own end\-to\-end design, Staff engineers define system\-wide patterns.


### **Backend \& Service Layer**



Build and evolve backend services that support:


* Long\-running workflows
* State management and persistence
* Error handling and fallback strategies
* Scalable API design

### **Real\-Time \& Event\-Driven Systems**



Implement real\-time patterns using WebSockets, SSE, or async workflows:


* Live updates
* Progress tracking
* Partial results and responsiveness


Make tradeoffs around latency, consistency, and user experience.


### **User Control \& Workflow Design**



Build systems that allow users to:


* Review and approve actions
* Override system decisions
* Intervene in workflows when needed


Senior\+ engineers help define how control, automation, and usability are balanced.


### **Performance \& Reliability**



Optimize across the stack:


* UI performance and rendering
* Backend query efficiency
* Caching and throughput
* System reliability and observability


Senior and Staff engineers define SLOs and performance standards.


### **Code Quality \& Mentorship**


* Write clean, testable, maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews
* Mentor junior engineers (Senior\+)
* Establish engineering standards (Staff)

### **Cross\-Team Technical Leadership (Senior \& Staff)**



Collaborate across frontend, backend, data, and platform teams to:


* Define shared patterns and abstractions
* Resolve architectural ambiguity
* Align engineering decisions with product goals


Staff engineers drive org\-wide technical direction.



 The **SDE\-2** level typically requires **3–5 years of full\-stack experience**, with strong skills in React and TypeScript on the frontend and experience with API design and basic database concepts on the backend. Candidates should have exposure to complex workflows, be familiar with asynchronous and real\-time patterns, understand user flows, and execute well\-scoped work effectively. Communication should be clear and structured.



The **Senior** level generally requires **5–8 years of full\-stack experience**, along with deep React expertise and strong backend systems knowledge, including queues, caching, and authentication. Candidates are expected to have built production\-grade systems and demonstrate strong architectural judgment, particularly around real\-time systems. They should be capable of designing for edge cases, evaluating tradeoffs, making independent technical decisions, and clearly communicating those tradeoffs across teams.



The **Staff** level typically requires **9\+ years of full\-stack experience** and expert\-level frontend architecture skills. Candidates should have deep expertise in distributed systems and infrastructure design, with experience designing large\-scale systems and defining real\-time infrastructure patterns. They are expected to shape both product and technology direction, provide organization\-level technical leadership, and effectively bridge business, product, and engineering teams.

  


**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Experience with real\-time UI updates and streaming data
* Familiarity with system evaluation and testing frameworks
* Experience in high\-stakes domains (fintech, logistics, etc.)
* Contributions to open\-source or internal tooling
* Experience scaling systems from early stage to maturity *(Staff)*


**Must\-have skills**
---------------------

title: . Net FSE Angular Developer
description:
Job Summary
  
We are looking for senior software engineer in a hybrid work model designing and delivering scalable web applications using net technologies Azure cloud services Angular TypeScript and modern JavaScript frameworks. Apply agile and scrum practices to build secure high quality solutions that support consumer lending and other enterprise business functions while improving customer experience and operational efficiency.
  
Responsibilities
  
Design and develop complex net based web applications using c sharp entity framework and rest api principles to deliver secure and scalable solutions for enterprise business needs.
  
Implement rich client side functionality using angular ten plus typescript javascript html css three point zero and bootstrap to create accessible and responsive user interfaces that comply with w three c web standards.
  
Collaborate with product owners business analysts and cross functional engineering teams in an agile and scrum environment to refine user stories estimate effort and plan iterative deliveries that align with business priorities.
  
Optimize application performance and reliability by profiling code tuning t sql queries and improving entity framework data access patterns to ensure efficient use of database and cloud resources.
  
Integrate azure services such as app services storage and monitoring tools into net applications to enhance scalability observability and maintainability across hybrid deployment environments.
  
Apply secure coding practices and web standards compliance in all front end and back end components to reduce defects improve accessibility and support inclusive digital experiences for diverse customer groups.
  
Conduct thorough code reviews and unit testing using industry standard frameworks to validate functionality maintain coding best practices and support continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines.
  
Work closely with quality engineering and operations teams to troubleshoot production issues analyze root causes and implement robust fixes that strengthen system stability and user trust.
  
Document technical designs api contracts and implementation details in a clear and structured manner so that other engineers can easily understand maintain and extend the solution.
  
Contribute to continuous improvement of agile processes by suggesting enhancements to sprint planning backlog grooming and review activities that increase delivery predictability and stakeholder satisfaction.
  
Participate in feature grooming sessions for consumer lending and related domains by translating functional needs into clear technical approaches that improve decision accuracy and customer transparency.
  
Align daily engineering activities with the organization purpose of delivering responsible and efficient financial services by building software that supports fair lending practices and simplifies digital interactions.
  
Provide technical guidance to peers on angular patterns net framework usage and azure integration options so that the broader team can adopt consistent approaches and reduce rework across projects.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Bring strong experience in net and net framework development using c sharp entity framework rest api design and t sql so that complex business logic and data workflows can be implemented reliably.
  
Demonstrate proficiency in modern web development using angular ten plus typescript javascript html css three point zero bootstrap and w three c compliant web standards to deliver accessible and responsive front end experiences.
  
Apply practiced knowledge of agile methodologies and scrum ceremonies to manage work items collaborate effectively and support incremental delivery of high value features to business stakeholders.
  
Utilize hands on expertise with azure cloud capabilities including hosting configuration and monitoring to design solutions that scale across hybrid environments while remaining secure and maintainable.
  
Draw on experience in consumer lending or related financial services domains as a nice to have capability to better understand credit products regulatory considerations and customer expectations.

title: Software Engineer (Python + React)
description:
**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------



The Software Engineer partners with cross\-functional product teams to design, develop \& maintain scalable software and AI\-enabled solutions that address user needs \& deliver measurable business value across the Food NA enterprise. Working with limited supervision in an agile, product\-focused environment, this role contributes throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery \& iterative development through deployment, support \& continuous improvement. The engineer writes clean, efficient \& maintainable code, applies responsible AI \& software engineering practices, troubleshoots moderately complex issues \& participates in code reviews and knowledge sharing while contributing to iterative delivery, production reliability \& continuous product improvement.

**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------


* Designs, develops \& maintains high\-quality software and AI\-enabled solutions using modern engineering practices, writing clean, scalable \& maintainable code that delivers measurable business value.
* Collaborates within an agile, cross\-functional product team to understand customer needs, refine requirements, participate in product discovery \& deliver solutions that achieve business outcomes.
* Applies DevOps, CI/CD, cloud\-native \& automation practices to improve deployment reliability, engineering productivity, operational excellence \& time\-to\-market.
* Implements automated testing, observability \& quality engineering practices to ensure software and AI solutions are secure, reliable, scalable \& performant.
* Contributes to the design, development, evaluation \& deployment of AI\-enabled capabilities, applying responsible AI, prompt engineering, model integration, retrieval techniques \& governance standards to deliver trusted business outcomes.
* Contributes to continuous improvement by reducing technical debt, improving engineering standards, adopting emerging technologies including AI capabilities where appropriate \& sharing best practices across teams.
* Demonstrates ownership of products and services in production by monitoring health, responding to incidents, participating in root cause analysis \& implementing long\-term improvements that enhance reliability and user experience.
* Other duties as assigned.
**Qualifications**
------------------


* Bachelor's degree in a related field with relevant work experience of minimum 4 years.
* Experience working with Python, React.js, Java, Postgres SQL, CSS, AWS
* Experience using tools like Jira, Confluence, GitHub
* Experience working with automated pipelines for continuous integration, testing, delivery and security
* Experience architecting applications, databases, services, or integrations.
* Minimum of four years of related work experience.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Proven ability to quickly learn new languages and platforms.
* Experience using AI\-powered engineering tools and assistants to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, automation, and overall developer productivity.
* Experience developing and supporting full\-stack solutions, including front\-end applications, APIs, integrations, data services, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience working within Agile product teams, collaborating with product managers, designers, architects, and engineers to deliver customer\-focused solutions through iterative development and continuous improvement.
* Experience building automated pipelines for continuous integration, testing, delivery and security or working with these types of automations.

title: UI Developer
description:
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. With 94,000 consultants and professionals globally, CGI delivers an end\-to\-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services, and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14\.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  

  

Job Title: UI Developer  

Experience: 4 to 6 yrs.  

Job Location: Bangalore  

Position ID: J0926\-0531  

Work Type: Hybrid  

Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  

Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  

  

Role Overview  

We are looking for a skilled UI Developer with 4–6 years of experience with strong hands on expertise in React, React Native, and TypeScript. The candidate will be responsible for developing scalable, responsive, secure, and high performing web and mobile applications, with a strong focus on modern UI architecture, real time data, state management, authentication, and automated testing.  

  

The candidate will work closely with UX/UI designers, backend developers, architects, QA teams, and business stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment.  

  

Core Technical Competencies
  

. React.js – Strong hands\-on experience with functional components, Hooks, reusable components, and modern React development patterns.  

. React Native – Experience developing cross platform mobile applications for iOS and Android.  

. TypeScript – Strong proficiency in developing type safe, scalable, and maintainable applications.  

. RxJS (Reactive Extensions for JavaScript) – Hands on experience with Observables, Operators, Subjects, and reactive programming patterns.  

. MUI (Material UI) – Experience developing responsive and reusable UI components using Material UI, theming, and customization.  

. Redux Toolkit – Strong understanding of state management using slices, actions, selectors, middleware, and asynchronous operations.  

. SSE / WebSocket – Experience implementing real time, event driven communication and streaming data.  

. OIDC / OAuth 2\.0 – Experience implementing secure authentication and authorization flows, token management, and integration with enterprise Identity Providers.  

. Jest \+ React Testing Library – Experience developing unit and component tests with a strong focus on code quality and test coverage.  

. Azure DevOps – Hands on experience with Azure Repos, Boards, Pipelines, CI/CD, automated builds, testing, and deployments.  

. REST APIs – Experience integrating front end applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.  

. Git – Strong understanding of version control and collaborative development practices.  

. JavaScript, HTML5 \& CSS3 – Strong understanding of modern web development fundamentals.  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

. Design, develop, and maintain modern web and mobile applications using React, React Native, and TypeScript.  

. Develop reusable, scalable, and maintainable UI components using MUI and established design standards.  

. Implement application state management using Redux Toolkit and reactive data flows using RxJS.  

. Implement real time communication and streaming data using SSE and WebSocket.  

. Integrate REST APIs and manage asynchronous data flows effectively.  

. Implement secure authentication and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2\.0\.  

. Integrate applications with enterprise Identity Providers and securely manage access and refresh tokens.  

. Develop unit and component tests using Jest and React Testing Library.  

. Configure and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment processes.  

. Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards, security practices, and development best practices.  

. Optimize applications for performance, scalability, security, accessibility, and responsiveness.  

. Troubleshoot and resolve application defects and production issues.  

. Collaborate with UX/UI designers, backend developers, architects, QA teams, and business stakeholders.  

. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.  

  

Good to Have
  

. Experience with Next.js or other React based frameworks.  

. Experience with enterprise Identity Providers such as Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, Auth0, or Okta.  

. Experience with Azure cloud services.  

. Knowledge of Docker and containerized application deployment.  

. Experience with design systems and reusable component libraries.  

. Understanding of application security, accessibility, and performance optimization.  

. Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.  

  

Qualifications \& Experience
  

. 4–6 years of hands on experience in UI/Front End development.  

. Strong practical experience with React, React Native, TypeScript, RxJS, MUI, Redux Toolkit, SSE/WebSocket, OIDC/OAuth 2\.0, Jest, React Testing Library, and Azure DevOps.  

. Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.  

. Good communication and collaboration skills with experience working in cross functional teams.
